notablePrerequisites: You have at least four permanent cards in your graveyard.
description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}{W}{W}
Cast Recruit the Worthy with buyback by paying {3}{W}, creating a creature token and returning Recruit the Worthy to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the creature token, untapping The Core.
Repeat.
